items.title: Sector entropy and relative entropy identities
items.statement: Let $I$ be a finite nonempty set. For each $\alpha\in I$, let $H_\alpha,K_\alpha$ be nonzero finite-dimensional complex inner-product spaces. A density matrix is a self-adjoint endomorphism with nonnegative eigenvalues and trace one; it is faithful when all its eigenvalues are strictly positive. Let $p_\alpha,q_\alpha>0$ with $\sum_\alpha p_\alpha=\sum_\alpha q_\alpha=1$, let $\rho_\alpha$ be a density matrix on $H_\alpha$, let $\sigma_\alpha$ be a faithful density matrix on $H_\alpha$, and let $\chi_\alpha$ be a fixed faithful density matrix on $K_\alpha$. items.title: Sector-dependent ancillary entropy
items.statement: Take two sectors with probabilities $p_1,p_2>0$ and $p_1+p_2=1$. Let $H_1,H_2$ be nonzero finite-dimensional complex inner-product spaces, choose density matrices $\rho_1,\rho_2$ on them, and choose $q_1,q_2>0$ with $q_1+q_2=1$ and faithful reference density matrices $\sigma_1,\sigma_2$ on the same spaces.
